title: Beyond the 956: Nicole Taylor, Taylor Red singer, dies at 35
excerpt: Taylor Red singer Nicole Taylor has died at 35. Her triplet sisters, Nika and Natalie Taylor, announced her death on November 2, 2026, after her battle with breast cancer.
content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

Taylor Red singer Nicole Taylor has died at 35.

Her triplet sisters and bandmates, Nika and Natalie Taylor, announced Nicole's death in a video posted on November 2, 2026. According to reports, Nicole died on September 28, 2026, in Nashville, Tennessee, and a private funeral had already been held.

Nicole was one of the three identical sisters who formed the country group Taylor Red. The sisters grew up playing instruments including guitar, banjo, fiddle and mandolin, and built a large following for their harmonies and country performances, including an appearance at the Opry 100 celebration in 2025.

Her sisters said Nicole was diagnosed with breast cancer in 2022. They described it as a very aggressive stage 3 cancer. She responded well to treatment at first and was declared to have no evidence of disease, but the cancer later returned and progressed to stage 4.

"We're heartbroken to announce the passing of our sister Nicole Taylor," Nika said in the announcement video. "We honestly thought she'd be healed here on earth, but now she's healed in heaven."

Natalie said Nicole faced the illness fearlessly, kept working, traveled, and tried to live life to the fullest. "She thought it fearlessly and she said, 'We're not going to live in dread during all of this,'" Natalie said.

Rest in Peace, Nicole Taylor.

Sources: PEOPLE; Page Six; HELLO! magazine, reporting the announcement by Nika and Natalie Taylor.
